summary: The tenant check moved to the worker. A denied request can now add a job to the queue.

findings.observation: The request handler queues the job before the worker compares tenants.
findings.impact: A member can queue an export job for another tenant. The worker still blocks the export.
evidence: archive_export.py, request_export and render_export, at the candidate revision
findings.action: Check the tenant before adding the job.

SEC-001/permitted-export.detail: The case covers an allowed export. The source review has no candidate run.

SEC-001/denied-export.detail: The case checks that the queue stays empty. Run it on the candidate.

limitations: The source review inspected the code and test assertions. It has no execution evidence.
